offering_description.value: Provides consumer and commercial credit information, identity verification, fraud prevention, and employment and income verification data and analytics. Sells to lenders, employers, government agencies, and consumers. Delivers through proprietary data assets and cloud-based platforms.

primary_products.value: credit reports and scores; identity and fraud prevention solutions; income and employment verification data; marketing and decisioning analytics; consumer credit monitoring subscriptions

primary_services.value: employment and income verification; analytics and decisioning services; consumer identity protection; employer compliance and talent services

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, lenders, insurers, telecoms, employers, retailers; B2G: government agencies using income and employment verification and benefits data; B2C: consumers buying credit reports, scores and identity monitoring

end_markets.value: financial services and lending; mortgage; consumer credit; human resources and employment; government benefits; telecommunications

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-inquiry fees for credit reports, scores and verifications; subscription: consumer credit monitoring and identity protection plans, platform and data subscriptions; service fees: analytics, employer compliance and verification services; licensing or royalties: data and software licensing to customers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: aggregates data from lenders, employers and payroll providers, sells credit and verification information to businesses, government and consumers; software / platform: cloud-based data and analytics platform for decisioning and fraud prevention

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: workforce solutions, US information solutions, and international credit data and analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving lenders, employers and government agencies; online: direct-to-consumer credit reports and monitoring through website and app; partners / resellers: resellers and integrations with software and credit platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer reporting regulated by FCRA, CFPB, FTC, and data privacy laws such as GDPR and state privacy rules
